verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature pages say users can create custom automation rules, including with Rovo AI, such as automated reminders and rules that move work forward. They also claim automation keeps Jira up to date "so you don't have to", which implies background execution. The evidence is marketing-level only: no documentation of triggers, recurring schedules, execution limits, or monitoring of autonomous runs. Missing for 10: detailed first-party automation docs covering triggers and recurring or background scheduling, execution limits and audit logs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
